title: MZ [Plugin Release] WisePot Free Plugins RPG MAKER MZ

posts.author: Wisepot
posts.body:
[Plugin Release] WisePot Free Plugins for RPG MAKER MZ
Hey RPG Makers!
I'm thrilled to announce the
WisePot Free Plugins Series
— a growing collection of powerful, flexible, and completely free utility plugins built specifically for
RPG Maker MZ
!
Whether you're crafting a rich offline story or building the framework for a multiplayer RPG, these plugins give you greater control over game logic, visuals, and system behavior — all while keeping development fun and manageable.
Available Plugins​
WisePot_Core
UI tweaks, player speed control, drop rate multipliers, vehicle landing rules, and a real-time damage tracker.
WisePot_Balloons
Enhanced balloon effects with customizable icon overlays and full event targeting.
WisePot_DateTime
Real-world time sync with timezone support. Great for birthdays, daily/weekly quests, and time-based systems.
WisePot_Menu
Add custom buttons to the menu, bind hotkeys to common events, and dynamically enable/disable them in-game.
WisePot_IWA
Add restrictions and passive effects to items, weapons, and skills based on actor, class, level, and map.
Plugin Highlights​
WisePot_Core
​
Title Screen Repositioning
— Move title commands anywhere.
Player Speed Control
— Set or change walking speed on the fly.
Drop Rate Multipliers
— Adjust EXP, Gold, and Item drops using variables & switches.
Battle Damage Tracker
— Save party damage totals for use in skills, achievements, etc.
Vehicle Restrictions
— Prevent landing in specific region IDs to control world access.
WisePot_Balloons
​
Use
standard balloons
or show
custom icons
(hearts, stars, etc.) from the IconSet.
Target
player, event ID
, or
"this event"
.
Customize icon
size, position
, and use a
custom base image
.
Fully integrates with
WisePot_Core
.
WisePot_DateTime
​
Sync with
real-world time
using any
IANA timezone
(e.g. Asia/Kolkata, UTC).
Store date/time values in variables: Year, Month, Hour, Weekday, AM/PM, etc.
Support for
daily rewards
,
birthday events
, cooldowns, and more.
Runs silently. use it with any picture or UI.
WisePot_Menu
​
Add
custom menu buttons
tied to any
Common Event
.
Assign
keyboard hotkeys
(e.g. A, B, C...) for instant in-game actions.
Dynamically toggle buttons/hotkeys via events.
Seamless with WisePot_Core.
️
WisePot_IWA
​
Use
notetags
to restrict who can equip/use items based on:
Actor ID, Class, Level, or Map
Add
passive effects
like:
passive_effect:hp:2 → +2 HP per minute
passive_effect:mp:-1 → -1 MP per minute
Auto-unequip when entering restricted maps.
Works with
items, weapons, armors, skills, and states
.
Example Notetags:
plaintext
CopyEdit
actor_id:1,2
class_id:3
level:10
ban_map_id:5,6
passive_effect:hp:-2
passive_effect:mp:3
